scope: Local Release verification of permission wait through AgentRunJournal
verified_paths: The real AgentRunner proposal-to-approval-to-read path executes with its journal-backed permission waiter.
The permission waiter contract covers persisted decisions, denial, cancellation, expiry, one-shot claims and workspace exclusion.
The selected runtime is used only for the native contract harness; no live model request or workspace product effect ran.
limitations: Permission grant lookup and writes still use AgentPermissionGrantStore over PersistenceService.
File, process, MCP and A2A effect executors still receive backend persistence directly.
This boundary is not an IPC approval or tool-dispatch implementation and is not a packaged CLI/web/VS Code acceptance run.
